title: SvgFeColorMatrix
responsibility: Renders the native feColorMatrix element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeColorMatrix.attributes
inputs.description: Native feColorMatrix attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgFeColorMatrix.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native feColorMatrix element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgFeColorMatrix
outputs.description: The actual native feColorMatrix element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
